scripts.build: rimraf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && pnpm run copy
scripts.build:docs: rimraf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && pnpm run docs:ci && pnpm run copy
scripts.check:raw: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm run spectaql:sync && pnpm audit && pnpm run check:overrides && pnpm peers check && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck:tests && pnpm test && pnpm run build && pnpm run check:prod-scripts && pnpm run check:server-start
scripts.check:server-start: pnpm run migrate:up && cross-env NODE_ENV=local node scripts/check-server-start.mjs --entry=dist/src/main.js --port-env=NSC__PORT --ready="Server starte[dt] at" --path=/
scripts.check:fix: pnpm install && pnpm run spectaql:sync && pnpm audit --fix && pnpm run check:overrides && pnpm peers check && pnpm run format && pnpm run lint:fix && pnpm run typecheck:tests && pnpm test && pnpm run build && pnpm run check:prod-scripts && pnpm run check:server-start
scripts.check:naf: pnpm install && pnpm run spectaql:sync && pnpm run check:overrides && pnpm peers check && pnpm run format && pnpm run lint:fix && pnpm run typecheck:tests && pnpm test && pnpm run build && pnpm run check:prod-scripts && pnpm run check:server-start
scripts.copy: pnpm run copy:assets && pnpm run copy:bin && pnpm run copy:config && pnpm run copy:extras && pnpm run copy:meta && pnpm run copy:migrations && pnpm run prune:migrations && pnpm run copy:public && pnpm run copy:scripts && pnpm run copy:templates && pnpm run copy:spectaql
scripts.dp:dev: pnpm run migrate:develop:up && cross-env NODE_ENV=develop node ./dist/src/main.js
scripts.dp:test: pnpm run migrate:test:up && cross-env NODE_ENV=test node ./dist/src/main.js
scripts.dp:prod: pnpm run migrate:prod:up && cross-env NODE_ENV=production node ./dist/src/main.js
scripts.docs: pnpm run docs:ci && node scripts/open.mjs http://127.0.0.1:8080/ ./public/index.html && compodoc -p tsconfig.json -s
scripts.docs:ci: node -r ./node_modules/@lenne.tech/nest-server/dist/core/modules/migrate/helpers/ts-compiler.js ./scripts/init-server.ts && pnpm run docs:bootstrap && compodoc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.migrate:develop:up: node scripts/require-built-migrations.mjs && cross-env NODE_ENV=develop migrate up --store ./dist/migrations-utils/migrate.js --migrations-dir ./dist/migrations
scripts.migrate:test:up: node scripts/require-built-migrations.mjs && cross-env NODE_ENV=test migrate up --store ./dist/migrations-utils/migrate.js --migrations-dir ./dist/migrations
scripts.migrate:preview:up: node scripts/require-built-migrations.mjs && cross-env NODE_ENV=preview migrate up --store ./dist/migrations-utils/migrate.js --migrations-dir ./dist/migrations
scripts.migrate:prod:up: node scripts/require-built-migrations.mjs && cross-env NODE_ENV=production migrate up --store ./dist/migrations-utils/migrate.js --migrations-dir ./dist/migrations
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm run lint && pnpm run test:e2e
scripts.reinit: rimraf pnpm-lock.yaml && rimraf node_modules && pnpm install && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test:e2e && pnpm run build
scripts.reinit:clean: rimraf pnpm-lock.yaml && rimraf node_modules && pnpm install && pnpm run test:e2e && pnpm run build
scripts.start: pnpm run migrate:up && pnpm run start:local
scripts.test: pnpm run vitest:unit && pnpm run vitest
scripts.test:ci: pnpm run vitest:unit && pnpm run vitest:ci
